title: Set up an AI tool
intro: Install, sign in, and test here. You can keep reading at any time.
close: Close setup and stop its action
cost_claude: You need Claude Code access on your Anthropic account. Free and paid offers can change. Check current plans before paying. Installing does not add a subscription.
cost_codex: Use your ChatGPT account. Free and paid plans have different limits. API billing is separate. VStudy supports only its audited macOS CLI version.
cost_agy: An eligible Google account can use free access where offered. Paid Google AI plans have different limits. Ask your school before sharing coursework.
privacy_copy: Sign-in stays with the tool. Questions and the context you share go to its provider. This test sends a tiny prompt without your documents and may use your allowance.
consent_help: Optional. No tool launches until you allow it and run a reviewed action.
consent_first: First allow this tool above. Then we will show its exact installation or sign-in plan before anything runs.
native_plan: VStudy checks the official download and keeps it in its own app folder.
command_plan: Only the named action below will run. Sign in through the provider's website if prompted.
copy_error: Could not copy. Select and copy the text above.
load_error: Could not load AI tools. Try again. No new action was approved.
ready_body: Your tool answered the test. Choose it in chat to ask about your reading.
test_success: Test answered successfully. The answer appears below.
action_success: Action completed. Review the next step above.
terminal_help: Type here only when this action asks you to. Login URLs and device codes appear here. Links always ask for confirmation.
terminal_error: The terminal could not send input, resize, or open a link. Stop and retry the action if needed.
truncated: Earlier output was removed to keep this pane small.
phase_cancelled: Stopped. You can review and try again.
new_chats: Updates and rollback apply to new chats. Ongoing sessions continue with their current version.
ask_title: Need help from your teacher or IT team?
ask_body: School-managed devices may block installation or accounts. Copy this request and send it yourself. You can keep reading without AI.
school_request: Could you help me use {{provider}} in VStudy Pro? I need an approved account and permission to install its official tool in VStudy's app data folder. Please confirm which coursework I may share and any costs.
optional: AI is optional. Your reading stays available.
updates_available: Updates available. Open a tool to review.
checked: Update check completed. Open a tool to review available versions.
inventory_error: Could not refresh tool status. Open setup to retry.
inventory: Update checks contact Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google's official release hosts with the tool, platform, and current version. Requests appear in the network inventory above. No documents or chat content are sent. Check now makes a single explicit request without enabling background checks.
pref_updateChecks: Check for updates in the background
pref_updateChecks_help: Off by default. When enabled, check at launch and every four hours. Cached results stay available offline.
pref_autoUpdateWhenIdle_help: Off by default. With update checks enabled, install compatible updates only when no chat or setup action is running.
pref_advancedShell_help: Off by default and separate from AI tool consent. A general shell can change or delete files and run arbitrary programs with your account's permissions.
preferences_error: Could not load or save this preference. Try again before relying on the change.
advanced_warning: For experienced users only. You do not need a general shell for guided setup. Review the action before opening it.
advanced_enable: Enable the separate advanced shell preference in Settings > Privacy first.
instruction_claude_install: Review the official Claude Code download below. VStudy verifies it and keeps a separate managed copy. Wait for installation to finish before signing in.
instruction_codex_install: Review the managed Codex installation below. VStudy uses only its audited compatible version. A newer release may need verification before it can be used.
instruction_agy_install: Review the official Antigravity download below. VStudy verifies it and keeps it in its app folder. Your Google sign-in comes next.
instruction_claude_login: Run the sign-in action, then follow the Claude website instructions shown below. Return here after approving access. Do not paste your password into this pane.
instruction_codex_login: Run device sign-in. Open the displayed OpenAI URL, enter the device code exactly as shown, and approve access. Keep this pane open until it finishes.
instruction_agy_login: Antigravity starts an interactive first-run screen. Follow its prompts below with the keyboard, choose Google sign-in, and return after browser approval. It has no separate login command.
instruction_claude_test: Ask Claude a tiny test question with tools disabled. The answer below confirms that your account can respond. Your documents are not included.
instruction_codex_test: Send a tiny question through VStudy's audited, tool-free Codex connection. A successful answer means you can choose Codex in a new chat.
instruction_agy_test: Send a tiny question through VStudy's tool-free Antigravity connection. Wait for its answer below before starting your first chat.
recovery_claude: For Claude, check that your account has Claude Code access. Retry sign-in if the session expired, or ask your teacher which account to use.
recovery_codex: For Codex, use the supported audited version and request a new device code if it expired. API credits and ChatGPT access are separate.
recovery_agy: For Antigravity, use the keyboard in the first-run screen to sign in with an eligible Google account. Ask IT if your school blocks this sign-in.
failure_offline: Check your internet connection, then retry. Cached update information is kept.
failure_permission-denied: VStudy could not write or launch the tool. Ask IT for permission to use the app data folder. Do not disable device protections.
failure_terminal-unavailable: VStudy could not prepare its terminal helper. Reinstall or repair VStudy, or ask IT to restore the helper's execution permission. You can still copy the sign-in command and use your own terminal.
failure_blocked: Your device or school policy blocked this action. Copy the help request below for IT.
failure_wrong-version: This version is not supported by VStudy's verified connection. Use a compatible managed version or ask IT. Newer is not always compatible.
failure_browser-not-opened: Open the sign-in URL shown below and follow the provider's instructions. If it expired, stop and start sign-in again.
failure_login-expired: Your sign-in expired. Review Sign in again to reconnect your account.
failure_not-signed-in: Sign in to your provider account first, then run the test again.
failure_checksum: The download did not pass its integrity check. Nothing was activated. Retry on a trusted connection or ask IT.
failure_signature: The publisher signature could not be verified. Do not bypass this check. Retry later or ask IT.
failure_unsupported: This tool or release is not supported on this device. Use another tool or ask IT for a compatible option.
failure_not-consented: Allow this tool explicitly before starting an action.
failure_cancelled: The action stopped. Review its plan to try again.
failure_busy: Another chat or setup action is running. Wait for it to finish before trying again.
failure_unknown: This action could not finish. Stop it if needed, review the plan, and retry. Ask IT if it keeps failing.
rollback_plan: VStudy switches its active pointer to the previous verified version. No global tool is changed and no shell command runs.
too_much_output: More output is available in Readable output and sign-in codes.
row_help: Use guided setup to install, sign in, and test here. The enable switch remains available for an existing installation.
onboarding_login_body: Use guided AI tool setup to install and sign in here. Each tool needs your permission before it runs. Provider plan limits and fees still apply.
which_tool_help: Start with an account your school approves. Installing a tool is free. Service access and limits depend on the provider and your account. Check the current offer before paying.
link_error: The plans page could not open. Try again or ask IT.
own_terminal_opened: Your terminal is open and the command is copied. Paste it there and press Enter. After sign-in, return here and review the account status check.
test_plan: VStudy sends a tiny question through its restricted connection. No documents are included.
status_plan: VStudy checks the existing Antigravity sign-in through its protocol. This action cannot open a browser.
transport_plan: VStudy tool-free test through the existing provider transport
transport_plan_footer: VStudy creates a private workspace and applies provider isolation. This is an action plan, not a command to paste.
installation_complete: Verified installation activated for new chats.
manual_install_help: If installing here fails, you or your IT team can use the official installer in your own terminal. It uses the vendor's folders and defaults, outside VStudy's managed copy. VStudy does not run this command. After installation, use Settings > Providers > Change to choose that executable, then check its status here.
